snippet.title: Flewberry Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Flewberry, the game about raising your own pet Birb, is available for free: https://alexgarbus.itch.io/flewberry

Alternatively, purchase the Kentucky Fried Pixels 2018 bundle for just a dollar and get access to Flewberry and 6 other great indie games: http://www.kentuckyfriedpixels.com
